operations.name: alerts.create
operations.description: Create an alert the app checks every minute (also with the window closed). Left side: price (default), --indicator, or --watch change. Right side: --value, --against an indicator, or --drawing a line. Examples: --op crosses_up --value 200; --indicator rsi --op below --value 30 --interval 1h; --op crosses --against sma --against_params {"length":50}.
operations.label: New alert

symbol.description: Symbol: AAPL, ^GSPC, EURUSD=X, GC=F, BTC-USD or BINANCE:BTCUSDT

interval.description: Interval of the bars the condition is read on (default 1D)

op.description: How the left side compares with the right side

value.description: Right side: a number (a price, an indicator level such as 30, or a percent with watch=change)

indicator.description: Left side: an indicator instead of the price, e.g. rsi (see indicators.catalogue)

params.description: Parameters of the left indicator as JSON, e.g. {"length":14}

output.description: Output of the left indicator when it has several (e.g. macd: macd, signal, hist)

against.description: Right side: an indicator, e.g. sma (price crosses SMA 50)

against_params.description: Parameters of the right indicator as JSON, e.g. {"length":50}

against_output.description: Output of the right indicator when it has several

drawing.description: Right side: a trend line, ray or horizontal line drawing id

watch.description: Left side: price (default) or change (today's % change)

notify_agent.description: Also send it to the AI agent, which explains what happened
